results.title: Evil Unearthed
results.overview: With seven years of documentation, the Paranormal Research Unit delves into the unsettling mystery of the Monroe House-culminating in the discovery of disturbing, ritualistic objects hidden beneath the most haunted house in Indiana.

results.title: The Devil's Hacksaw
results.overview: After escaping Greystone Asylum, a vengeful inmate terrorizes a quiet Pennsylvania town with a brutal killing spree, sending residents into panic.

results.title: Tango in Room 1310
results.overview: Brimming with hope, Patrick arrives in the city to propose to his girlfriend. But when the night takes an unexpected turn, he discovers that new beginnings also come in unexpected ways.

results.title: Fearless
results.overview: Already harassed by the neighborhood bully for entering a hip-hop contest, two young brothers, who have never danced, have only three days to prepare and overcome the deep insecurity of one brother.

results.title: Three of a Kind
results.overview: Luis and her mother Christel are stunned when matriarch Vivi arrives unannounced for the holidays. The three women clash under one roof as secrets are revealed - and ultimately must decide if they will stay divided or finally come together.

results.title: Don’t Believe A Word I Say
results.original_title: Don’t Believe A Word I Say
results.overview: Exploring boyhood, masculinity, and working class folklore on a Doncaster council estate — where the world might be ending.

results.title: given: Moments in Life
results.overview: Mafuyu, Ritsuka, Haruki, Akihiko, and Ugetsu return in a collection of short stories.

results.title: In a Time of Uncertainty
results.overview: In the final hours of 2021, a chance encounter between two out-of-luck young actors leads to an intimate but unstable relationship. With their careers stalled and their emotions unbalanced by the epidemic, they seek solace in each other, but they can't tell if it's love or just a physical need. How do they find true companionship when everything is uncertain, and desire and vulnerability are intertwined?

results.title: Losing Season
results.overview: A woman left alone at her boyfriend's house one morning after he's left for work has a life-altering encounter with a younger woman who shows up at the door and claims to have grown up there.

results.title: Halabala
results.original_title: ฮาลาบาลา ป่าจิตหลุด
results.overview: Inspector Dan leads the team of infirm police officers to hunt down the brutal escaped prisoner in the Halabala forest down south, only to discover that the dark secret inside the forest is turning against them.

results.title: Panopticon
results.overview: When Sandro’s father decides to devote his life to God and leaves for a monastery, the teenage introvert finds himself deprived of the fundamental certainties of life. Abandoned by his father and his mother, who is working abroad, the young man embarks on a journey of self-discovery, opening up both to a new friendship with the radical Lasha, who has ties with an ultra-right organisation, and also to the chance to explore his own sexuality.

results.title: Flunk: The Girl That Got Away
results.original_title: Flunk: The Girl That Got Away
results.overview: Celeste, now in university, finds herself unable to move on without the love of her life Ingrid. But will tracking Ingrid down bring her the happiness she’s seeking?

results.title: Mordrik
results.overview: When headstrong Merrin, trapped in the rhythms of her family's mussel-picking trade, stumbles upon a mysterious hagstone, she unwittingly sets off a chain of events that challenges her family ties, and the unseen forces shaping their mundane lives.

results.title: Me No Pause Me Play
results.overview: Me No Pause Me Play is a heartwarming and empowering story of women navigating life's transitions, rediscovering their strength, and redefining identity beyond age, delivering a powerful message of awareness and acceptance around menopause.

results.title: No Shade In The Forest
results.overview: The film tells the story of an eco-journalist's journey through war-torn Ukraine. She documents the scale of ecocide in national parks, meets scientists who continue their work even amid the sounds of explosions, and begins to record the audio atmosphere of the destroyed territories. By comparing them with pre-war archives, the protagonist creates a unique study that adds a new, profound dimension to the documentation of war crimes.

results.title: Jeez, Louise!
results.overview: Mary Louise, a devout catholic, has a steamy confession that unbeknownst to her is heard by Eden, the school's sex maniac.

results.title: Dormant
results.overview: Three kids are looking for something to do on the outskirts of the city. One of them finds a dying animal. The three boys engage in a discussion about what to do with it that will determine their moral judgement.

results.title: Pond
results.overview: A fish gets lost in a tidal pool and must win over the sea creatures that dwell there. A fart creates goodwill, and a strong community quickly develops. An underwater adventure painted with the colours and sounds of the sea.

results.title: Pocket Change
results.overview: When the power goes out at a roadside diner in the middle of nowhere, a mysterious drifter and his seemingly worthless quarter hold the key to saving everyone from a deadly threat.

results.title: Killer in the Woods
results.overview: Teens head out into the woods to find a crashed meteorite and instead come across the survivor of a massacre and its perpetrator, the killer in the woods.
